    {
      "_content": "<h3>A worker pushes a crate with 200 N, and the crate pushes back with 200 N. Why does the crate still accelerate forward?</h3>",
      "_source": "",
      "_type": "text",
      "_answers": [
        {
          "_content": "<p>The worker's push happens slightly before the crate pushes back.</p>",
          "_isCorrect": false,
          "_color": ""
        },
        {
          "_content": "<p>The forces act on different objects</p>",
          "_isCorrect": true,
          "_color": ""
        },
        {
          "_content": "<p>The worker has more mass, canceling the crate's reaction force.</p>",
          "_isCorrect": false,
          "_color": ""
        },
        {
          "_content": "<ul><li>Gravity redirects the crate's backward reaction force into the floor.</li></ul>",
          "_isCorrect": false,
          "_color": ""
        }
      ],
